texto.es: Cuéntanos qué piso tienes hoy y qué quieres cambiar; una foto del espacio ayuda a orientarte rápido.
texto.en: Tell us what floor you have today and what you want to change; a photo of the space helps us get you a quick read.

texto.es: Medimos el área y te damos el costo del material y la instalación antes de empezar, sin letra chica.
texto.en: We measure the area and give you material and installation costs before starting, no fine print.

texto.es: Vitor y su equipo llegan con el material acordado y ejecutan el trabajo con el cuidado que mencionan nuestros clientes.
texto.en: Vitor and the team arrive with the agreed material and do the work with the care our customers mention.

texto.es: Revisamos el piso terminado contigo y dejamos el área limpia, lista para usarse.
texto.en: We walk the finished floor with you and leave the area clean and ready to use.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el metraje y el material elegido. Escríbenos y te damos el presupuesto sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on square footage and the material you choose. Message us and we will walk you through the estimate, no strings attached.

texto.es: Cambiamos baldosa por piso de madera en casas completas, como el proyecto de 2019 que varios clientes mencionan en sus reseñas.
texto.en: We swap tile for hardwood flooring across full homes, like the 2019 project several customers mention in their reviews.

texto.es: De alfombra a madera o de un piso viejo a uno nuevo: actualizamos recámaras y áreas completas.
texto.en: From carpet to hardwood, or an old floor to a new one: we update bedrooms and full living areas.

texto.es: Un equipo de instaladores profesionales que nuestros clientes describen como cuidadoso y puntual, de principio a fin.
texto.en: A team of professional installers our customers describe as careful and punctual, from start to finish.

items.quote: I have highly recommended Vitor since day one of his business. If you are looking for top-tier flooring business, he is the best in the trade. He is exceptionally professional, honest, and reliable.

My involvement with Supreme Floors was the most exceptional service related experience I've had since moving to Florida 20 years ago. The quality of their work, their reliability and the professionalism of their workers is second to none. The owner Vitor is a pleasure to work with and an expert in his craft.
If you're looking to upgrade your floors and increase the value of your home, call Vitor and his team of very professional installers and they'll bring up the value of your home.
